name: Control Tangent
source:
This is a very short and simple visual novel I made just for this jam. It's only 1,300 words long. I hope you enjoy it.

[From [url=https://unicodepepper.itch.io/control-tangent] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是我为本次创作活动制作的一部非常短小简单的视觉小说，全文只有1300词。希望你能喜欢。

[来源：[url=https://unicodepepper.itch.io/control-tangent]itch.io[/url]]
